security_spec.violation_condition: When spmpcfg registers are implemented as 16-bit storage elements (per the pre-change spec) but the indirect CSR access via sireg2 reads/writes at SXLEN width, the upper SXLEN-16 bits are not preserved on write (WPRI violation) and expose uninitialized register-file or internal bus state on read, because the hardware fails to allocate full SXLEN-width register storage for each spmpcfg[i] entry.
security_spec.summary: spmpcfg[i] widened from 16-bit field to SXLEN-bit register; hardware must allocate SXLEN-width storage with WPRI on bits [SXLEN-1:10] or risk info leak through unsanitized upper bits on sireg2 reads
